marking_points.text:  reaction time between hearing the splash and stopping the stop-watch  the sound (of the splash) takes time to reach the student or the stone hits the water at a different time to the sound being heard or the sound (of the splash) has to travel to the student  the student might not let go of the stone from ground level  the student might not let go of the stone and start the stop-watch at the same time  stop-watch may not be properly calibrated / has a zero error  (local value of) g is not (exactly) 9.81 (m s2)  stone given initial velocity / initial velocity not zero  stone does not fall (exactly) vertically / in a straight line Any three points, 1 mark each
precise: results are close together / have little scatter
not accurate: the values are not close to / 50% different / (very) different from the true value
